title: Contract-test CI coverage and ownership boundary transfer
required_human_authorities: Product Owner disposition of RFC-2026-003 before the manual merge described in RFC-2026-002
purpose: Correct two committed bootstrap defects recorded in RFC-2026-003: npm run check never executes the shared-kernel contract tests, and committed package writable globs capture the declared outputs of every planned follow-on contract package. Both fixes are reversible, synthetic-only, and change no contract, status, provider, schema, or gate.

include: RFC-2026-003 decision record for the test-glob fix and the ownership boundary transfer
package.json test:bootstrap glob correction so npm run check executes test-kits/**/*.test.mjs
Anthropic capability declarations for the distinct Claude Code role runs used by this package
Author, independent Reviewer, Security, Tester, and Integration Owner evidence and handoffs for this package
exclude: Contract freeze-level advancement, other package status advancement, production schema, migrations, provider SDKs, credentials, customer data, network calls, native branch protection, merge authorization, and Gate G0 approval

authorized_cross_package_amendments: work-packages/WP-0A-A0-001.json — remove package.json from writable_paths and outputs.files only (RFC-2026-003 decision 2)

work-packages/WP-0A-CON-001.json — replace the contract-catalog/shared-kernel/**, test-kits/contracts/**, and unused fixtures/contracts/** writable globs with the exact paths that package delivered (RFC-2026-003 decision 3)

acceptance_criteria: npm run check executes every test-kits suite including test-kits/contracts and reports 32 passing tests on pinned Node 24.20.0 / npm 11.19.0.
node scripts/validate-work-package-ownership.mjs work-packages exits 0 with no cross-package writable/output overlap.
WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-CON-001 declared outputs remain fully covered by their remaining writable_paths after the amendment.
The two cross-package manifest amendments are limited to the exact removals authorized by RFC-2026-003 and are declared in authorized_cross_package_amendments.
No contract status, package status other than this package, provider, schema, credential, or gate state changes.
The Author does not review, security-review, test-verify, or integrate this package.
required_tests: npm run check on the pinned toolchain, asserting contract tests are included
Ownership validator across all work-package manifests
Capability-profile validator for all declared role runs
Negative check that the previous glob missed test-kits/contracts and the corrected glob does not
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert the RFC, package.json, manifest, capability-profile, evidence, and handoff changes through a reviewed revert PR. Reverting restores the previous test glob and the previous ownership boundaries exactly; no persisted data, provider state, credential, migration, or customer-data effect exists.
open_blockers: RFC-2026-003 is Proposed and requires independent Reviewer, Security, Tester, and Integration Owner evidence plus Product Owner disposition before the RFC-2026-002 manual merge.
Role assignments beyond Author are null until each independent run records its own capability declaration; the package must not advance past backlog before then.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; this package is restricted to reversible, synthetic-only work.

The WP-0A-CON-001 review, test, and integration evidence cited npm run check while contract tests were excluded; the Integration Owner must record whether that evidence needs re-execution against the corrected command.
